WGU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 82.5 competency units from other sources can count toward the 110-unit degree.
  • WGU caps alternative credit at 82.5 competency units.

Source: WGU November 2026 undergraduate catalog: transfer ceiling and named degree requirements

Published university rate: $3,925 per 6 months. The number of paid terms depends on the work you finish. Outside courses and separate charges are additional. See the rate source.

Questions

Does Sophia Health, Fitness, and Wellness transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Health, Fitness, and Wellness for C458 Health, Fitness, and Wellness (4 competency units) in the Information Technology, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Philosophy 104: Contemporary Trends in Technology and Ethics transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com Philosophy 104: Contemporary Trends in Technology and Ethics for D773 Technology and Ethics: Emerging Trends and Society (3 competency units) in the Information Technology, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Saylor Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Saylor Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic for D265 Critical Thinking: Reason and Evidence (3 competency units) in the Information Technology, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Western Governors University’s Information Technology?

WGU’s published limit for this 110-unit degree is 82.5 competency units from other sources. This plan proposes 29 competency units through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Western Governors University?

In this plan, 81 competency units are taken at WGU, including E006 Digital Transformation in the Enterprise, D522 Python for IT Automation and E005 Business Productivity Software.

Has Western Governors University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need WGU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: how many credits must I earn at the school itself for this degree? Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always WGU’s decisions.
